summary.text: Luck Gamble is an immortal killer move named when Qin Ding Ling slams her hands on Immortal Zombie Giant Sun's back.

claims.text: Golden Hooped Great Immortal finishes a killer move that costs his life and cultivation. Mysterious light falls on Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s head and becomes a golden hoop on his forehead, leaving his mind and body slightly sluggish. Qin Ding Ling appears behind him and slams her hands on his back.

A black and white Gu worm resembling a die flies out of her phantom aperture, rolls rapidly, and stops. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun shows three. The die rolls again and Qin Ding Ling shows five. In an instant his vast luck transfers to her. Her body shakes, her face reddens, and her teeth clatter. She can only endure with all her strength and has no strength to fight for the moment.

She tells him that to deal with him she gave up metal path, sealed and buried herself deep under the earth in a metal coffin, and spent three hundred thousand years comprehending luck path. During that seclusion, gamble Gu was attracted to her and came to the metal coffin one day.

After she recovers she activates the killer move again. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun shows three. Qin Ding Ling shows two. Her luck surges out and transfers back to him. The numbers determine victory or defeat, but the outcome is random. Even Qin Ding Ling, the user, cannot influence it.

Gamble Gu has no offensive power by itself. It is powerless no matter what the result is. The luck gamble killer move that uses it as the core is extremely dangerous. Whether it succeeds or fails, there is no way to predict it. Because of that characteristic, even Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s luck cannot interfere with it. The probability of winning is equal for both Immortal Zombie Giant Sun and Qin Ding Ling.

Whether she loses or wins, Qin Ding Ling only profits. Luck is categorized into good luck and bad luck, and its size varies. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s luck is extremely vast, at Dao Lord level, with little bad luck and good luck occupying the majority. Qin Ding Ling’s luck is far smaller. Bad luck occupies most of it. She is only a rank eight expert, so her luck is naturally smaller than his. She is basically gambling with a smaller chip. When her luck transfers to him, it contaminates his luck as well.

If she wins more and loses less, Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s luck greatly decreases. If she wins less and loses more, even though he obtains her luck, it mostly contains bad luck. He has methods to transform bad luck into good luck, but that process spends immortal essence and mental energy. If he turns his bad luck into good luck and then loses the next luck gamble, he would be reinforcing the enemy.
Qin Ding Ling is still in the process of revival. Luck gamble was already used before and would be difficult to use again with Giant Sun Immortal Venerable already on guard against it.
Star Constellation Immortal Venerable planned before taking action. Since she could prepare the killer move luck gamble against Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, she would not neglect Fang Yuan.

Qin Ding Ling comes out of the starry paths and uses the killer move once again, targeting Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. Almost at the same time, Golden Hooped Great Immortal appears again and uses his golden hoop to trap Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. If Giant Sun Immortal Venerable is struck by these methods, his combat system’s foundation is hit and he falls into a disadvantage. Even if he is not hit, he has to slow down for a while to deal with Qin Ding Ling and Golden Hooped Great Immortal.

Qin Ding Ling is waiting to strike. She has the killer move luck gamble, created to counter Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. She cannot do anything against Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, but she can deal with Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. She is waiting for a chance.
